summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder never received the goods, and that the address on the order is not the cardholder's address and they did not authorise delivery there.
summary.to_defend: Visa requires proof the goods were delivered to the cardholder's address on or before the chargeback date, with carrier, tracking and a delivery address that matches what the cardholder gave at purchase.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery
requirements.text: Proof of delivery: tracking number, carrier name, and confirmation of delivery to the cardholder's address.
requirements.finding: The DPDx tracking page gives a carrier, tracking number 15441288821100 and a DELIVERED status on 10 April 2025 to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR, but the parcel was left in a safe place with no signature or photo, and the recipient is shown only as "Lumatech Customer" rather than the cardholder's name.
requirements.gap: No signature, no proof-of-delivery photo or GPS stamp, and the recipient line does not name the cardholder, so delivery to the cardholder personally is not shown.

citations.quote:
Tracking number: 15441288821100
Status: DELIVERED
Delivered: 10 April 2025, 15:22

requirements.title: Service rendered
requirements.text: For services: evidence the service was rendered on or before the expected date (booking confirmation, attendance log, access logs).
requirements.finding: This is a physical goods order for headphones and an iPad shipped by DPDx, so no service was rendered.

requirements.title: Delivered before chargeback date
requirements.text: Date of delivery / service rendered is on or before the chargeback date.
requirements.finding: Delivery is recorded on 10 April 2025, the day after the 9 April 2025 purchase, well before the chargeback was raised.

requirements.title: Delivery address matches
requirements.text: The delivery address materially matches the address provided by the cardholder at purchase.
requirements.finding: The parcel went to exactly the address entered at checkout, Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR, but that postcode differs from the billing postcode M14 5RT, AVS returned N (no match) and the cardholder denies the address is theirs.
requirements.gap: Nothing links the shipping address to the cardholder: no prior undisputed orders to that address, no account history, no customer contact confirming it.

alerts.text: The cardholder states the delivery address is not theirs; the merchant evidence only shows the address was typed at checkout and the billing postcode M14 5RT does not match the shipping postcode M1 7DR, with AVS returning N.
Evidence for R1, R3 was read from an image. Check the highlight.

reasons: Key evidence read from an image
Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

justification: Delivery to the checkout address is documented, but nothing yet ties that address or the order to the cardholder, and the merchant can plausibly supply that link.
rationale:
The issuer claims non-receipt and says the delivery address is not the cardholder's.
DPDx tracking 15441288821100 shows the £642.00 order LT-200931 delivered on 10 April 2025 at 15:22 to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR, the address entered at checkout.
The parcel was left in a safe place with no signature or photo and the recipient is named only as "Lumatech Customer", so receipt by the cardholder is not evidenced.
The shipping postcode M1 7DR differs from the billing postcode M14 5RT, AVS returned N and 3DS was only attempted, which leaves the address link unproven.
Representment should wait until the merchant supplies carrier proof of delivery detail and account history tying that address to the cardholder.
merchant_requests: Request the full DPDx proof of delivery for tracking 15441288821100, including any signature, safe-place photo or GPS coordinates for the 10 April 2025 delivery.
Provide the customer account history for a.carter****@gmail.com showing prior undisputed orders shipped to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR.
Provide login or order records showing IP 188.29.44.179 or device fingerprint fp_c01e84f2b9 used on earlier undisputed orders on the same account.
Supply any post-delivery correspondence with the cardholder (order tracking emails, delivery notifications, support tickets) for order LT-200931.
Confirm whether the cardholder's name and billing address at M14 5RT appear anywhere on the account, and provide the checkout record showing the shipping address was chosen by the customer.
